query:
SELECT u.id FROM users u
           WHERE u.org_id = $1 AND u.is_active
             AND (u.id = $2 OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur
                JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
                WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.builtin IN ('owner','admin','bookkeeper')))
           LIMIT 50
